title: Logout inhibition for GTK apps under Wayland is ignored
line: Logging out no longer ignores apps that block it through the desktop portal, such as GTK apps with unsaved documents; the logout is canceled with a notification.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.6 xdg-desktop-portal-kde records apps that inhibit logout through the portal and exposes the result as org.kde.SessionState.queryCanEndSession, but nothing in plasma-workspace ever called it. ksmserver went straight into closing the session, so a GTK app holding a logout inhibitor was ignored and the session ended. Now ksmserver's closeSession asks the portal first (without starting it if it isn't running) and, if an app blocks, cancels the logout and shows the existing 'Logout canceled' notification.

commits.message:
ksmserver: ask the portal whether apps block logout before logging out

Apps that block logout through the XDG desktop portal, like GTK apps
with unsaved documents, were ignored and the session ended anyway. Ask
the KDE portal first and cancel the logout with a notification if so.

BUG: 496282

media.caption: With a portal logout inhibitor held ('Unsaved document'), Log Out leaves the session running and shows 'Logout canceled because an application is preventing it'.
